ValidationRule.description: Enforces IDR_NC_Postcode field to be alphanumeric or have the value 'Not Applicable'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint', NOT(ISBLANK(IDR_NC_Postcode__c)), AND(NOT(REGEX( IDR_NC_Postcode__c , "^[0-9]{4}$")), NOT(LOWER(IDR_NC_Postcode__c)='not applicable'), NOT(LOWER(IDR_NC_Postcode__c)='overseas')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Postcode must be a 4-digit Australian postcode. If the customer is overseas, enter 'Overseas', if the postcode is unknown, enter 'Not Applicable'.
